record.context_brief: rational curves from positive bisectional curvature
record.original_question: Suppose the tangent bundle TM of a manifold M carries a Hermitian metric, not assumed Kähler, with positive bisectional curvature. Can one produce rational curves on M by an analytic method?

evidence.quote: Question 4.5. Suppose TM has a Hermitian metric (without assuming it is Kähler) with positive bisectional curvature, can one produce rational curves on M by an analytic method ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a compact complex manifold whose holomorphic tangent bundle $TM$ admits a Hermitian metric $h$ (not assumed to come from a Kähler metric on $M$) with positive bisectional curvature; that is, the Chern curvature $\Theta(h)$ of $(TM,h)$ satisfies
$$\Theta(h)(X,\overline X,Y,\overline Y) > 0$$
for every pair of nonzero vectors $X,Y \in T_pM$ at every point $p\in M$.

Develop an analytic method (for instance via harmonic maps from $\mathbb{P}^1$, deformation of holomorphic disks, or related variational/PDE techniques, as opposed to purely algebro-geometric bend-and-break arguments) that produces a non-constant holomorphic map $\mathbb{P}^1 \to M$, i.e. a rational curve on $M$, from such a Hermitian metric of positive bisectional curvature.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal extensive related work on positive bisectional/real bisectional curvature in the Hermitian (non-Kähler) setting, including criteria for rational connectedness via mean curvature positivity of the tangent bundle and classification results for compact Hermitian manifolds with various positivity conditions. However, no source explicitly resolves the question of constructing rational curves on a compact complex manifold whose tangent bundle carries a (non-Kähler) Hermitian metric with positive bisectional curvature by an analytic method. The status is therefore not clearly established as solved.

status_evidence.title: On real bisectional curvature for Hermitian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Real bisectional curvature for Hermitian manifolds is introduced; coincides with holomorphic sectional curvature in the Kähler case.
status_evidence.claim: Related curvature notions in non-Kähler Hermitian setting are studied but the analytic production of rational curves is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Fundamental group, rational connectedness and tangent bundle (L. Ni)
status_evidence.snippet: A compact Kähler manifold is projective and rationally connected iff its holomorphic tangent bundle is mean curvature positive.
status_evidence.claim: Differential-geometric criteria for rational connectedness exist in the Kähler case; the non-Kähler Hermitian analytic construction remains separate.
